reason: A web UI plugin that replaces write and edit tool result rows with an enhanced diff viewer supporting highlighting, folding, virtualization, copying, and nested call display.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 的 write 和 edit 工具调用提供支持高亮、折叠、窗口化渲染与复制功能的增强型 diff 查看器。
summaries.en: An enhanced diff viewer for DSH Web GUI write and edit tool calls with highlighting, folding, virtualized rendering, copying, and nested-call support.

capabilities: Replaces the web UI rendering for write and edit tool calls
Displays unified or split diffs with syntax and word-level highlighting
Supports context folding, virtualized rendering, copying, and nested write/edit diff views
